snippet.title: 50 Minutes of Early Gameplay | Crimson Desert
snippet.description:
(This video contains actual in-game footage. As a work-in-progress, the content is subject to change.) 
In the vast wilderness of the continent Pywel, Kliff, captain of the Greymanes, embarks on a quest to reunite his scattered comrades and fulfill the group's mission. Experience part of Kliff's journey in this Crimson Desert 50-minute early gameplay video. 
This gameplay video consists of different parts of Crimson Desert’s early gameplay and has been edited to help viewers’ understanding.  

What is Crimson Desert?  
Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure game developed by Pearl Abyss, aiming for a global release on console and PC platforms. Through vibrant storytelling and intense action, Crimson Desert depicts realistic characters and narratives that revolve around the members of the Greymanes fighting to achieve their noble mission.
Experience the beautiful yet brutal continent of Pywel, where you will witness the conflicts and epic sagas surrounding Kliff, the leader of the Greymanes, as his mission takes him on an unforgettable journey. 

Join Crimson Desert's official channels and subscribe to the newsletter on our website to stay updated! 

Learn more:  
» Official Site: https://crimsondesert.pearlabyss.com  
» Steam:  https://pearlabyss.info/wlen5s
» https://twitter.com/crimsondesert_  
» https://instagram.com/crimsondesert_  
» https://discord.gg/crimsondesert  
» https://facebook.com/crimsondesert 

#CrimsonDesert #OpenWorld #Gameplay 

About Pearl Abyss  
Best known for the Black Desert franchise, Pearl Abyss is a leading developer in the game industry. Established in 2010, Pearl Abyss has since developed Black Desert for PC, mobile, and console. The company is currently developing Crimson Desert, DokeV, and PLAN 8 on a next-gen proprietary engine. More information about Pearl Abyss is available at: https://www.pearlabyss.com
